decisions.statement: A call is spelled with a space between each level of the command tree.
What each level names itself says where one level ends and the next begins.
A level whose own name carries a hyphen keeps that hyphen.
A slug naming no level of the command tree is left alone.
A slug with no `akasha` before it names a page rather than a call.
A piece of a template literal is judged as a whole string literal is.
Only the file holding a page's code is judged.
A name built as the code runs is not seen.

definition: the rule refusing a call spelled in one word where its levels want spaces
